'''Karm''' is a Quartermaster in the [[Seanchan]] army under the command of [[Tylee Khirgan]].

== Activities ==
After the [[Battle of Malden]] while traveling back to [[Ebou Dar]] he finds all the traveling rations have turned to dust.
